independence: Non-author page reviewer; did not author the learner or key and made no changes to either master or TeX.
method: Every assigned page was actually opened through view_image at original resolution and visually examined. Hash checks below bind those inspections to the current PDF and images; they did not replace visual review.
checks: All page content visually readable within the page measure
Old English letters, macrons, ash and e-ogonek clear where present
Tables and wrapped rows aligned without clipping or collision
Prompts, models and target explanations kept in complete answer units
Reading passages, all eighteen original notes, ten numbered helps and final citations readable
Headers, footers, page numbers and section transitions unobstructed
